title.en: Take notes from a health segment
title.es: Tomar notas de un segmento de salud

es: Tomar notas de un segmento de audio sobre salud separando la idea principal, los detalles, los ejemplos y la recomendación.

teaching.en: Take a note of the main idea first, and then add the details.
teaching.es: Anota primero la idea principal y después añade los detalles.
teaching.explanationEs: Take a note = anotar: primero lo principal y después lo que lo apoya.
segments: Take a note of the main idea
first, and then add the details.
teaching.audioText: Take a note of the main idea first, and then add the details.

teaching.en: A detail explains the main idea with research, numbers or an example.
teaching.es: Un detalle explica la idea principal con investigaciones, cifras o un ejemplo.
teaching.explanationEs: Los detalles y los ejemplos apoyan la idea principal; no son la idea.
segments: A detail explains the main idea
with research, numbers or an example.
teaching.audioText: A detail explains the main idea with research, numbers or an example.

teaching.en: The main idea of this segment is that a good habit can improve your sleep.
teaching.es: La idea principal de este segmento es que un buen hábito puede mejorar tu sueño.
teaching.explanationEs: La idea principal es lo que el locutor quiere que recuerdes; suele decirse al principio o al final.
segments: The main idea of this segment is that
a good habit can improve your sleep.
teaching.audioText: The main idea of this segment is that a good habit can improve your sleep.

teaching.en: The benefit is more energy, and the risk is tiredness if you stay up late.
teaching.es: El beneficio es más energía y el riesgo es el cansancio si te acuestas tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Benefit y risk suelen ser detalles: ventajas y peligros que apoyan la idea.
segments: The benefit is more energy, and the risk
is tiredness if you stay up late.
teaching.audioText: The benefit is more energy, and the risk is tiredness if you stay up late.

teaching.en: The speaker's recommendation is simple: put the phone away an hour before bed.
teaching.es: La recomendación del locutor es sencilla: guarda el móvil una hora antes de dormir.
teaching.explanationEs: La recomendación es lo que el locutor te pide que hagas; suele ir al final.
segments: The speaker's recommendation is simple: put the
phone away an hour before bed.
teaching.audioText: The speaker's recommendation is simple: put the phone away an hour before bed.

teaching.en: «For example» introduces an example; it is a detail, not the main idea.
teaching.es: «Por ejemplo» introduce un ejemplo; es un detalle, no la idea principal.
teaching.explanationEs: For example y first, second, also anuncian detalles: no los confundas con la idea principal.
segments: «For example» introduces an example; it is
a detail, not the main idea.
teaching.audioText: «For example» introduces an example; it is a detail, not the main idea.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la idea principal del segmento.

choices.text: Homework is the best way to get better marks.
Good sleep helps students remember what they study.
Students should study more hours every night.

feedback.es: El segmento contradice la idea de que más deberes dan mejores notas y concluye que dormir bien ayuda a recordar.

hint.es: La idea principal suele repetirse al final, tras un «so».

origin.audio: Welcome back to Health Today. Many people think that more homework means better marks. The research says the opposite: students who sleep well remember more. So the message today is simple: sleep is part of studying.

prompt.es: Completa: «Por ejemplo, los adolescentes duermen seis horas.»

feedback.es: For example introduce un ejemplo, que es un detalle que apoya la idea principal.

hint.es: Es la preposición que también traduce «por».

prompt.es: Ordena: «La idea principal es que dormir bien ayuda.»

answer.text: The main idea is that sleeping well helps

feedback.es: La idea principal se expresa con The main idea is that + oración.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige un detalle que apoya la idea del segmento.

choices.text: Coffee is better than water in the morning.
Headaches are caused by too much homework.
Water before an exam can make students feel calmer.

feedback.es: El ejemplo final da un detalle concreto: beber agua antes de un examen calma a los estudiantes.

origin.audio: Drinking enough water helps you think. First, it gives you more energy in the morning. Second, it helps you concentrate in class. Third, it stops headaches. For example, students who drink water before an exam often feel calmer.

prompt.es: Elige la nota que es la idea principal de este esquema.

choices.text: Teenagers need more sleep than they get.
Research says most go to bed after midnight.
Advice: keep the same bedtime every day.

feedback.es: La idea principal abarca todo el esquema; la investigación es un detalle y el consejo es la recomendación.

origin.text:
1) Research: most teenagers go to bed after midnight.
2) They sleep six hours; they need nine.
3) Advice: keep the same bedtime every day.
4) Teenagers need more sleep than they get.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada nota con su lugar en el esquema.

pairs: For example, six hours is too little.
Put the phone away at ten.

feedback.es: La idea es el mensaje central, el ejemplo apoya con un caso y la recomendación dice qué hacer.

pairs: For example, six hours is too little.
Put the phone away at ten.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la recomendación de la doctora.

choices.text: Buy a new phone with a better screen.
Leave the phone outside the bedroom at night.
Sleep two more hours on Sundays.

feedback.es: La doctora aconseja cargar el móvil fuera del dormitorio: esa es la recomendación del segmento.

origin.audio: Many teenagers spend more than four hours a day on their phones. The research shows that this reduces their sleep. The doctor's advice is to charge the phone outside the bedroom and to keep the same bedtime every day.

prompt.es: Completa el esquema con las palabras clave del segmento.

feedback.es: El esquema recoge la idea (dormir mejor), dos detalles (estrés y energía) y la recomendación (caminar despacio).

sentences: Main idea: a short walk helps you ___ better.
Detail 3: you have more ___ the next day.
Recommendation: walk ___ and avoid hard exercise at night.
origin.text: Transcripción: «A short walk after dinner helps you sleep better. First, it lowers stress. Second, it gives your body time to rest. Third, it gives you more energy the next day. The doctor's advice is simple: walk slowly and do not do hard exercise late at night.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el papel de la frase sobre dormir seis horas.

choices.text: It is the main idea of the segment.
It is the recommendation for listeners.
It is a detail that supports the main idea.

feedback.es: Empieza con for example: es un ejemplo que apoya la idea de que una noche corta causa cansancio.

origin.audio: Why do we feel tired in the afternoon? The main reason is a short night. For example, sleeping only six hours can reduce your attention a lot.

prompt.es: Escribe la recomendación del locutor con recommends + -ing.

answer.text: The speaker recommends stopping coffee after noon.
accepted: The speaker recommends stopping coffee after noon.
The speaker recommends not drinking coffee after noon.
The speaker recommends stopping drinking coffee after noon.
The speaker recommends that people stop drinking coffee after noon.
The speaker recommends stopping coffee after midday.

feedback.es: La recomendación se resume con recommends + -ing: stopping coffee after noon.

origin.text: Segmento: «Many adults drink coffee after lunch. The research shows that coffee late in the afternoon can delay sleep. So my advice is to stop drinking coffee after noon.»

prompt.es: ¿Qué papel tiene esta frase en un segmento?

choices.text: It gives an example that supports an idea.

feedback.es: Here is one case presenta un caso concreto: apoya la idea, no la formula ni cierra el segmento.

origin.text: «Here is one case: walking for ten minutes can improve your mood.»

prompt.es: Ordena: «La recomendación del locutor es dormir siete horas.»

answer.text: The speaker's recommendation is to sleep seven hours
accepted: The speaker's recommendation is to sleep seven hours
The recommendation of the speaker is to sleep seven hours

feedback.es: La recomendación suele ir al final y se expresa con is to + verbo.

prompt.es: Completa: «La investigación dice que los adolescentes duermen poco.»

feedback.es: Research es incontable y lleva verbo en singular: the research says.

origin.text: The research ___ that teenagers sleep too little.
